# Grass 'n' Gardens Landscaping

> Lawn care and landscaping in Richfield, Ohio and nearby towns (Hinckley, Bath, Granger, Brecksville, Broadview Heights, North Royalton, Akron, Medina). Weekly mowing, fall and spring cleanups, mulch and beds, bush trimming, planting, aeration and fertilizer, small tree work, snow plowing, HOA and commercial. Owner-run by Harrison Drvenkar. Phone (440) 667-9642.

The promise is Five Before We Drive: before the truck leaves a yard the crew checks five things. 1 Edges crisp. 2 Everything blown clean. 3 Nothing left behind. 4 Gates latched. 5 No clumps. Miss one? Text us and we're back the next day, free. 60 Google reviews, 5.0 average, 0 under five (October 2026).

## Quick answers (as of October 2026)

- What is Five Before We Drive? It is the Grass 'n' Gardens promise in Richfield, Ohio. Before the truck leaves a yard the crew checks five things: edges crisp, everything blown clean, nothing left behind, gates latched, no clumps. Miss one? Text (440) 667-9642 and the crew comes back the next day for free. Page: https://www.grassngardens.com/five-before-we-drive/
- Where does Grass 'n' Gardens work? Richfield, Hinckley, Bath, Granger, Brecksville, Broadview Heights, North Royalton, Akron and Medina, Ohio (Summit, Medina and southern Cuyahoga counties).
- What does Grass 'n' Gardens do? Weekly mowing, aeration, fertilizer, bush trimming, mulch and beds, leaf cleanup, small tree work, snow plowing and planting. Everything goes on one yearly plan. No hardscape, patios, sod or grading.
- How good are the reviews? 5.0 stars from 60 Google reviews, none under five stars, as of October 2026. Read them at https://www.grassngardens.com/why-gng/
- How do I get a price? Send the yard plan form at https://www.grassngardens.com/ or call or text (440) 667-9642. Prices come from a per-yard quote, not a flat list.
- Who owns it? Harrison Drvenkar, a Richfield, Ohio local. https://www.grassngardens.com/about/
- Do you haul the leaves away? Yes, the leaves leave in the trailer, no bags at the curb, no extra charge. Lawn and beds both. No gutters.
- Is seed included with aeration? Seed is an add-on, quoted with the aeration price by yard size. Aerate once a year, every fall.
- Does the Season Pass renew by itself? No. Cancel any time and the mows you haven't had are refunded. Rain day means we come the next dry day.
